children: The Democratic sweep of both chambers of Congress removes unwelcome uncertainty from markets says, Lombard Odier's global chief investment officer Michael Strobaek. The election won't have a significant impact on markets, Strobaek says. However, he said he is "happy to get some of the randomness out of the equation." The sector most affected will be energy because of the unique scale of President Trump's support for the sector, Strobaek says. Tech is not a Republican domain only, Lombard Odier chief economist Samy Chaa adds. Democrats have demonstrated in the past that they are also invested in the progress of technology, for example through President Joe Biden's Chips and Science Act. S&P 500 futures slip 0.1%. (josephmichael.stonor@wsj.com)
